label: run156 ecrs requirement probe
definition: (PROBE — REJECTED) run155a keeper + measured ECRS reserve requirement ON from 2023 (ercot_ecrs_requirement). Tested the May-2024 under-price hypothesis. Verdict: rejected. The flat +~2 GW ECRS reserve add does NOT fix May 2024 (load-wtd $23.6->$24.0, target $38-45) because May is not physically reserve-thin in the model — the co-opt ORDC steps only bite in genuinely-thin hours, so the add OVERSHOOTS Aug 2024 ($30.4->$53.5 vs actual 36) and catastrophically over-fires 2023-H2 (annual $48->$128, Aug $147->$598; no storage-AS credit in 2023). Battery throughput held (2024 0.78 TWh). Confirms the May miss is DAM ancillary-service co-optimized scarcity (hypothesis 4), not RT energy/reserve thinness. Keeper remains run154/run155a.
